releaseNotes:
- Fix claude models on Antigravity: carry the tool call id on Gemini functionCall parts. Omitting it made the upstream reject every request with 400 "tool_use.id: Field required" once a conversation had used a tool (808fa8a)
- Fix the same missing-id failure on the Claude passthrough path (8cf5509)
- Fill in a missing tool_use.id when history lost it, on the executor path (47b6dda)
- Auto-compact: address the provider's /compact path and strip the client-only _compact marker before dispatch (7a13d40)
- New OAuth connections are ranked so they join the account rotation instead of sorting last (9860b5e)
- A never-tested account no longer renders as a failed one (a5ad2f0)
- Dashboard: provider cards show "connection N" under the name (00ddfbd)

Update from the dashboard (sidebar button) or run `9router-go --update`.
